data.reasoning: Deepseek successfully reviewed all repository files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, .gitignore) and found them to be standard, safe packaging files that download official Microsoft binaries with SHA-512 checksums. Qwen's inconclusive result was solely due to API errors preventing it from reviewing the PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO, not due to any security concerns.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool failure. Qwen encountered HTTP 400 errors when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO, resulting in an inconclusive verdict, while Deepseek successfully audited the same files and found them safe.
coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to review PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400)
learnings: The audit tool should handle LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) gracefully, perhaps by retrying, rather than immediately marking critical files as inconclusive.
When aggregating reports, a tool error resulting in an inconclusive verdict should not override a complete and safe verdict from another model reviewing the same files.
